verification.method: scripts/verify/singapore.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank, share, growth, density 1950/2026, land area; densest country or area over 1 million; urban share 100% in every year
Fertility under 1, fifth lowest among places over 1 million; 2010 low; 1956 high; under 2.1 since 1975; births peak 1958 and now
Median age 2026/2050/2100, largest rise to 2050 among countries over 5 million; life expectancy highest in South-Eastern Asia
Declines 2002–2003 and 2020–2021, each with net outflow, 2020 the largest; natural increase
Peak 2040, deaths above births from 2038, 2100 total equal to the 2004 level; title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 66 of 66 checks match
UN WUP 2025 original file WUP2025-F15-National-Definitions_percPop_by_category.xlsx (SHA-256 5fdc43a9…, downloaded 2026-11-25); licence CC BY 3.0 IGO stated in the file
verification.result: All figures match. Comparisons name the size group used (countries over 1, 5 or 50 million) so small territories do not change the ranking. The page explains no causes the UN data do not show. No image alt text on the page (the flag and charts carry aria-labels).
